shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白的作业票
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank work permit form on a clipboard, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第一课：作业许可制度。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣身后是实验楼改造的围挡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a laboratory building with renovation barriers and a scaffold.
shots.narration: 实验楼要施工维修，先办票再动手。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 实验室改造，施工工人拿着切割机走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: A contractor worker carries an angle grinder into a chemistry lab that still has reagent bottles on the bench.
shots.narration: 实验室改造，工人拿着切割机就进来了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰发现通风柜里还有溶剂瓶，旁边是气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices solvent bottles in a fume hood and a gas cylinder near the work spot.
shots.narration: 旁边还有溶剂和气瓶，阿杰很紧张。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师赶来拦住，举手示意停
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hurries in and raises a hand to stop the worker.
shots.narration: 王老师：停！作业票办了吗？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老周（施工方负责人）挠头
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the contractor foreman, scratches his head holding no paperwork.
shots.narration: 老周：就切一会儿，不用那么麻烦吧？

shots.section_title: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住
shots.scene: 一套按步骤走的流程图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chain of steps from a plan to a check to work to closing, each with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 按一套程序干活，就是安全工作制度。
overlay: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住

shots.section_title: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住
shots.scene: 授权人签发，限定地点和时间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an authorized person signing a blank permit, a location pin icon and a clock icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 作业许可：授权人签发，限定地点时间。

shots.section_title: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住
shots.scene: 措施一项项打勾后才开工
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with every item ticked, then a green start icon for the work. No text.
shots.narration: 措施一项项落实了，才能开工。

shots.section_title: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住
shots.scene: 风险被盾牌挡在开工前
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield blocking hazard icons before they reach a work area. No text.
shots.narration: 目的是防止事故，把风险挡在动手前。

shots.section_title: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住
shots.scene: 存档盒、考勤表打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an archive box, an attendance sheet and an audit folder, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不是为了存档、考勤、应付检查。

shots.section_title: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住
shots.scene: 施工、维修、修理三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a building construction, a repair wrench and a maintenance toolbox. No text.
shots.narration: 它授权的是特定的施工维修作业。

shots.section_title: 哪些作业要办票
shots.scene: 动火、受限空间、高处三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a welding spark, a manhole and a person on a scaffold. No text.
shots.narration: 国内对特殊作业实行作业票管理。

shots.section_title: 哪些作业要办票
shots.scene: 吊装、临时用电、动土、断路图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a crane hook, a temporary power cable, a shovel digging and a blocked road. No text.
shots.narration: 还有吊装、临时用电、动土、断路。

shots.section_title: 哪些作业要办票
shots.scene: 电气作业、射线装置旁维修、压力试验图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an electrical panel, a radiation warning sign beside an x ray cabinet and a pressure test gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 电气、射线装置旁、试压，也要审批。

shots.section_title: 哪些作业要办票
shots.scene: 射线装置停机，拉起警戒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an x ray cabinet switched off with a barrier tape and a radiation warning sign around the work area. No text.
shots.narration: 射线装置旁维修，先报批、先停机。

shots.section_title: 哪些作业要办票
shots.scene: 一项工程拆成几张票
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one renovation job splitting into three separate blank permits, each with its own icon. No text.
shots.narration: 一项工程几种作业，分别办票。

shots.section_title: 哪些作业要办票
shots.scene: 以本校规定为准的文件夹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a school rule book with a blank cover next to a national standard book. No text.
shots.narration: 具体分类，按国家标准和本校规定。

shots.section_title: 只有低风险才能免办
shots.scene: 扫地、看一看、擦灰尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three low risk tasks, sweeping a floor, a visual check and light dusting. No text.
shots.narration: 清扫、目视检查，风险低可以免办。

shots.section_title: 只有低风险才能免办
shots.scene: 动火、射线、试压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three high risk tasks, welding, radiography and a pressure test, each with a warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 动火、射线、试压，风险高必须办。

shots.section_title: 只有低风险才能免办
shots.scene: 时间短、花钱少打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stopwatch and a coin icon, both crossed out next to a skipped permit. No text.
shots.narration: 时间短、图省事，都不是免办理由。

shots.section_title: 只有低风险才能免办
shots.scene: 签发人判定，接收人不能自己说了算
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer deciding with a tick, a worker deciding alone crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 是不是低风险，由签发人判定。

shots.section_title: 只有低风险才能免办
shots.scene: 拿不准时按要办票处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a question mark icon leading to a blank permit with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 拿不准，就按需要办票来处理。

shots.section_title: 限制区：进去作业先办票
shots.scene: 危化品库、气瓶间、储罐区的门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: doors of a chemical store, a gas cylinder room and a tank yard, each with a restricted area sign. No text.
shots.narration: 有易燃易爆危险的区域叫限制区。
overlay: 限制区：进去作业先办票

shots.section_title: 限制区：进去作业先办票
shots.scene: 食堂、宿舍不算
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a canteen and a dormitory icon with a plain door, no restricted sign. No text.
shots.narration: 食堂、宿舍、垃圾站，一般不算。

shots.section_title: 限制区：进去作业先办票
shots.scene: 管理者在平面图上划出限制区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a manager marking restricted zones on a blank floor plan of a campus building. No text.
shots.narration: 哪里划为限制区，由学校管理部门定。

shots.section_title: 限制区：进去作业先办票
shots.scene: 限制区门口：先办票再进入作业
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker at a restricted area door showing a blank permit before entering. No text.
shots.narration: 在限制区作业，要先办作业票。

shots.section_title: 限制区：进去作业先办票
shots.scene: 危化品实验室实行准入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical lab door with an access card reader and a sign in book. No text.
shots.narration: 危化品实验室准入，要负责人同意。

shots.section_title: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责
shots.scene: 签发人和接收人两个角色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer as issuer on one side and the older man as receiver on the other, a blank permit between them. No text.
shots.narration: 签发人签票，接收人领票干活。
overlay: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责

shots.section_title: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责
shots.scene: 签发人对设备和区域负责
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer standing in front of the equipment and the work area he is responsible for. No text.
shots.narration: 签发人对设备和区域负责，签了不撒手。

shots.section_title: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责
shots.scene: 接收人是经过培训授权的熟练技工
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the older man with a blank qualification card and a training certificate. No text.
shots.narration: 接收人是经过培训授权的熟练工人。

shots.section_title: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责
shots.scene: 资格证有有效期，到期复训
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank qualification card with a calendar icon and a renewal arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 资格证由授权主管签发，到期复训。

shots.section_title: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责
shots.scene: 签发前核对资格证、取得会签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer checking a qualification card and a second signature box being signed. No text.
shots.narration: 签发前，核对资格证，取得会签。

shots.section_title: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责
shots.scene: 【实拍】接收人逐条读空白作业票后签字（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand running a finger down each line of a blank permit form, then signing at the bottom.
shots.narration: 接收人读懂、同意全部条件再签字。

shots.section_title: 签发人与接收人：有资格、各负其责
shots.scene: 两人一起扛着盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the issuer and the receiver holding one shield together over the work area. No text.
shots.narration: 现场安全，签发人和接收人共同负责。

shots.section_title: 联合现场检查与安全交底
shots.scene: 签发人和接收人一起走到现场
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the older man walk into the lab work area together with a blank permit.
shots.narration: 签发前，两人一起到现场检查。
overlay: 联合现场检查与安全交底

shots.section_title: 联合现场检查与安全交底
shots.scene: 看同一个现场后分别签字
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two people looking at the same work spot, then two signature boxes being signed. No text.
shots.narration: 看过同一个现场，再分别签字。

shots.section_title: 联合现场检查与安全交底
shots.scene: 三个问题：干什么、用什么、有何特殊
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a task list, a toolbox and a warning triangle, connected to the work spot. No text.
shots.narration: 说清干什么、用什么、有何特殊情况。

shots.section_title: 联合现场检查与安全交底
shots.scene: 排风管里可能有化学残留
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway of a fume hood exhaust duct with chemical residue inside, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 比如排风管里，可能有化学残留。

shots.section_title: 联合现场检查与安全交底
shots.scene: 王老师向施工方讲解实验室危险点
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points out the gas lines, chemical cabinet and exhaust duct to the older man.
shots.narration: 工人可能从没来过，危险要当面讲清。

shots.section_title: 联合现场检查与安全交底
shots.scene: 按步骤拆分作业，逐步找危害
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a job broken into numbered steps, each step with a hazard icon and a control icon. No text.
shots.narration: 开工前做作业危害分析，逐步找风险。

shots.section_title: 联合现场检查与安全交底
shots.scene: 确认设备工具已备妥
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire extinguisher, a gas detector and tools laid out and ticked before work starts. No text.
shots.narration: 工具、消防器材，开工前确认备妥。

shots.section_title: 票上写的是这项活的控制措施
shots.scene: 照抄法规条文、通用清单打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a copied rule book page and a generic checklist, both crossed out, a task specific list with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 票上写的，是针对这项活的措施。
overlay: 票上写的是这项活的控制措施

shots.section_title: 票上写的是这项活的控制措施
shots.scene: 隔离：关阀、断电、上锁挂牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed valve with a lock, a switched off breaker with a tag. No text.
shots.narration: 隔离：关阀、断电、上锁挂牌。

shots.section_title: 票上写的是这项活的控制措施
shots.scene: 清走可燃物，移走化学品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: chemical bottles and paper boxes being moved out of the work area on a trolley. No text.
shots.narration: 清走可燃物，移走化学品和气瓶。

shots.section_title: 票上写的是这项活的控制措施
shots.scene: 专业人员作业前做气体检测
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trained person holding a gas detector at the work spot before work, a green tick on the screen. No text.
shots.narration: 需要时，作业前由专人做气体检测。

shots.section_title: 票上写的是这项活的控制措施
shots.scene: 监护人全程在场
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a watch person standing beside the work area with a fire extinguisher during the whole job. No text.
shots.narration: 安排监护人，全程在场不离开。

shots.section_title: 票上写的是这项活的控制措施
shots.scene: 清单最后加一行，现场需要更多就加
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a list of controls with an extra line being added at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 票上是最低措施，现场需要就加。

shots.section_title: 票在现场：有效期、交接与叫停
shots.scene: 【实拍】作业票装进透明袋挂在作业现场（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a blank work permit in a clear sleeve hung at the entrance of a work area beside a barrier.
shots.narration: 作业票放在现场，谁都能看到。

shots.section_title: 票在现场：有效期、交接与叫停
shots.scene: 票上写着谁干、干什么、到几点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a permit icon pointing to a worker icon, a task icon and a clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 谁在干、干什么、到几点，一目了然。

shots.section_title: 票在现场：有效期、交接与叫停
shots.scene: 过期的票打叉，重新办
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a permit with a calendar showing it has expired, crossed out, a new permit with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 票有有效期，过期要重新办。

shots.section_title: 票在现场：有效期、交接与叫停
shots.scene: 换班交接：票和现场一起交代
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two workers handing over a permit and pointing to the work site together. No text.
shots.narration: 换人接班，把票和现场交代清楚。

shots.section_title: 票在现场：有效期、交接与叫停
shots.scene: 地点、内容变了，重新办票
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a work location pin moving to a new room and a new permit being drawn up. No text.
shots.narration: 地点、内容变了，就要重新办票。

shots.section_title: 票在现场：有效期、交接与叫停
shots.scene: 违规、紧急情况、恶劣天气：叫停
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a rule broken, an alarm bell and a storm cloud, each leading to a stop hand. No text.
shots.narration: 违规、紧急情况、恶劣天气，立即叫停。

shots.section_title: 完工验收再关票
shots.scene: 工人清理现场，带走工具和材料
shots.prompt_en: The older man and a worker sweep the floor and carry tools and leftover materials out of the lab.
shots.narration: 完工后清理现场，带走工具材料。

shots.section_title: 完工验收再关票
shots.scene: 老李和王老师检查设施恢复正常
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the safety administrator check that the exhaust fan and gas lines work normally again.
shots.narration: 签发人和实验室负责人一起检查。

shots.section_title: 完工验收再关票
shots.scene: 【实拍】在空白作业票的关闭栏签字（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand signing the closing section at the bottom of a blank work permit form.
shots.narration: 确认设施恢复正常，再关票。

shots.section_title: 完工验收再关票
shots.scene: 实验室恢复实验
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student returns to the lab bench and switches on the fume hood.
shots.narration: 关票之后，实验才能恢复。

shots.section_title: 保命规则：红线一条都不能碰
shots.scene: 一张写着十条红线的空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank card with ten red line icons on it. No text.
shots.narration: 很多单位都定了保命规则。
overlay: 保命规则：红线一条都不能碰

shots.section_title: 保命规则：红线一条都不能碰
shots.scene: 无票不作业、不隔离不作业
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, work without a permit crossed out and work without a lock crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 无票不作业，不隔离不动手。

shots.section_title: 保命规则：红线一条都不能碰
shots.scene: 不检测不进受限空间，不系安全带不登高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: entering a manhole without a gas test crossed out, climbing without a harness crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不检测不进受限空间，不系安全带不登高。

shots.section_title: 保命规则：红线一条都不能碰
shots.scene: 吊物下不站人，不擅自变更
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing under a lifted load crossed out, a changed plan without approval crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 吊物下不站人，不擅自变更作业。

shots.section_title: 保命规则：红线一条都不能碰
shots.scene: 实验室里私自关报警打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off a lab gas alarm, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室里，报警装置也别私自关掉。

shots.section_title: 实验楼改造维修中的作业许可
shots.scene: 改造方案交实验室管理部门审批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a renovation plan passing from the lab to the school lab management office and the logistics office for approval. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室改造维修，先办审批。
overlay: 实验楼改造维修中的作业许可

shots.section_title: 实验楼改造维修中的作业许可
shots.scene: 施工前移走化学品、关好气源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: chemicals packed out of the lab and gas valves closed with tags before workers arrive. No text.
shots.narration: 施工前移走化学品，关好气源。

shots.section_title: 实验楼改造维修中的作业许可
shots.scene: 实验室负责人向施工方交代危险点
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks the older man through the lab pointing at hazards on a blank floor plan.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人向施工方交代危险点。

shots.section_title: 实验楼改造维修中的作业许可
shots.scene: 电工、登高架设人员出示操作证
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrician and a scaffold worker each showing a blank operator certificate card. No text.
shots.narration: 电工、登高架设，要持证上岗。

shots.section_title: 实验楼改造维修中的作业许可
shots.scene: 动火、临时用电、进受限空间分别审批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three blank permits for hot work, temporary power and confined space entry, each with a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 动火、临时用电、受限空间，都要审批。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 作业票和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a blank permit and a shield. No text.
shots.narration: 作业许可：开工前把风险挡住。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 签发人和接收人一起到现场
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, two people at a work site and a checklist. No text.
shots.narration: 联合检查，当面交底，措施落实。

shots.section_title: 小结
